title: WIN-041 patch-2 verification: Terra-Nova 2017 DOI is wrong (points to unrelated seismic paper) — exact-replacement fix + optional Finlay 2020 cite
summary: Decider patch 2 from WIN-041.c3 (ISS-2603) integrated the boundary-decay rebuttal with citation 'Terra-Nova et al. 2017' hyperlinked to https://doi.org/10.1093/gji/ggx374. CrossRef verification shows that DOI resolves to Katou et al. 2017/2018, GJI 212(1):509-521, 'Reciprocal data acquisition and subsequent waveform matching for integrated onshore-offshore seismic profiling' — an unrelated seismology paper. The correct citation is Terra-Nova, Amit, Hartmann, Trindade & Pinheiro (2017), 'Relating the South Atlantic Anomaly and geomagnetic flux patches', Phys. Earth Planet. Inter. 266:39-53, DOI 10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002 — the SAME DOI our own WIN-004 detail_evidence already uses. The scientific substance of patch 2 otherwise verifies: Finlay et al. 2020 (CHAOS-7, EPS 72:156) abstract directly confirms the secondary SAA minimum southwest of Africa and its connection to reversed-flux evolution at the CMB, and the axisymmetry argument is consistent with dome baseline parameters (H0=8537, decay=8619 per poller 2026-06-06). Verdict assessment: KEEP Misleading (see verdict_assessment).

patches.rationale: Current DOI resolves to an unrelated seismic-profiling paper. A defender who clicks our citation in the key boundary-decay rebuttal finds a paper about onshore-offshore seismic surveys — exactly the kind of checkable factual error our review exists to catch in others. Replacement DOI verified via CrossRef and matches WIN-004 existing usage.

verdict_assessment.question: Decider asked whether WIN-041 verdict should strengthen beyond Misleading.
verdict_assessment.reasoning: (1) c3 itself: current_verdict_holds=true, confidence 0.9, recommended_action=minor_edit. (2) Cross-WIN coherence: the WIN-004/005/035 'Std Model Explains' vs WIN-037/041 'Misleading' split is deliberate (mechanism-explained vs count-inflation); strengthening 041 alone breaks it. (3) The station decay rates are real and the dome arithmetic is internally consistent — the failure is count inflation + post-hoc registration + relabeling standard SV structure, which is precisely what Misleading denotes; a 'False/Refuted'-class verdict would overclaim and hand the dome a legitimate grievance. Counter-case considered: the dome's own Registered-2026-03-15-vs-2022-2024-window metadata is a clean post-hoc concession, but post-hoc packaging of true observations is still Misleading, not False.
